sections.heading: PI gain starting points
sections.text: Same as LLC: kp ~ fr/Vout (Hz/V), ki ~ fr/(5*Vout) (Hz/(V*s)). The LCC gain curve depends on the Cp/Cr ratio. Higher Cp makes the gain curve flatter, requiring higher gains.

sections.heading: Gain direction
sections.text: Same as LLC: increase kp for faster response, reduce kp if frequency oscillates. LCC has a wider control range than SRC but narrower than LLC for the same tank parameters.

sections.heading: Sample time
sections.text: Same as LLC: sample time <= 1/(10*fsw_max). For a 200 kHz LCC, sample at <= 5 us.
